messages:
kevin_sales: customer on POC acct=acct_ENTER1 reports free credits fell from 45k -> 0 overnight and they saw lots of 429s during a morning load run. demo blocked. can we swarm? :scream:
jo_support: on it. ask for SDK/version, a short client log snippet, and whether they have any retryers or queue workers.
kevin_sales: customer sent this snippet and said they're using node-sdk v2.0.0-rc with a lambda that retries on failure:
```
2026-04-10T09:02:11Z WARN request timeout, retrying
2026-04-10T09:02:12Z INFO request sent tokens=1200 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-04-10T09:02:14Z ERROR http 429
2026-04-10T09:02:16Z INFO request sent tokens=2400 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-04-10T09:02:19Z INFO success req_id=req_p9 tokens=2400
```
ana_engineer: that token jump is interesting (1200 -> 2400) — looks like the lambda concatenates prior context on retry. can we pull server-side request list for acct_ENTER1 09:00-09:10?
infra_bot: usage alert: acct_ENTER1 soft-spend threshold breached at 2026-04-10T09:03:00Z. current window consumption=45,120 units.
mike_billing: billing view shows free_credit was 45,000 at 08:55 and 45,120 consumed by 09:05. usage_alert_bot flagged anomaly: high variance in tokens/request.
jo_support: customer also mentions they saw a flurry of 429s before things completed. concurrency and retry interplay likely. ana, any quick thought?
ana_engineer: pulling logs... server snippet: 
```
[2026-04-10T09:02:12Z] req=req_p7 status=408 tokens=1200 route=/v1/chat/completions
[2026-04-10T09:02:16Z] req=req_p8 status=200 tokens=2400 route=/v1/chat/completions
[2026-04-10T09:02:22Z] req=req_p9 status=200 tokens=2400 route=/v1/chat/completions
```
ana_engineer: looks like two accepted 2400-token requests after an initial 1200-timeout. likely the retry sent an expanded payload (lambda appended history) and the original was still processed or accepted by our gateway. both consumed.
mike_billing: that would explain the unexpected spend. do we have a dedupe or idempotency guidance for node-sdk rc?
jo_support: customer using a custom retry wrapper in lambda that doesn't set X-Idempotency-Key. node-sdk v2.0.0-rc's default behavior around idempotency is still opt-in in this RC. recommend immediate mitigation: 1) pause the lambda retry (for demo), 2) set idempotency header per invocation, 3) lower concurrency or add jitter. provide sample.
ana_engineer: sample header: 
```
X-Idempotency-Key: 1a2b3c4d-... (uuid per logical task)
```
plus a quick usage query: 
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDFW" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/usage?account=acct_ENTER1&start=2026-04-10T08:50:00Z&end=2026-04-10T09:10:00Z" | jq .
```
kevin_sales: customer says they rely on lambda retries because their infra is edge-heavy. they want a guarantee we won't double-bill during POC. can we offer a short-term credit while they patch?
mike_billing: finance policy allows goodwill credits for transparent client-side misconfig when POC risk is high. need eng confirmation of duplicate volume. ana, estimate duplicate amount?
ana_engineer: conservative dedupe estimate: out of 45,120 consumed, approx 22,800 tokens look like duplicates (pairs of similar requests where earlier attempt timed out). recommend credit ~22,800 and restore free_credit to 45k so demo proceeds.
jo_support: ops action: can infra bump their per-account concurrency and temporarily relax 429 thresholds while they fix? infra_bot?
infra_bot: tentative change: increase concurrency for acct_ENTER1 8 -> 20 for 6h. change_id=cfg_20260410_07. Will auto-revert after 6h.
mike_billing: queued credit note: acct=acct_ENTER1 amount=22800 reason="duplicate consumption from lambda retries and payload concatenation" status=pending_approval.
kevin_sales: customer reply: "Pausing retries and adding idempotency now. Thanks for the credit offer and the quick bump, this saves our demo." :relieved:
jo_support: additional suggestion: if customers must use retries in serverless, encourage setting a dedupe key in task metadata and checking request status endpoint instead of blind retries. also recommend SDK upgrade when v2 stable.
mike_billing: filing audit entry referencing server logs and eng dedupe calc. finance will approve after 2PM review.
usage_alert_bot: scheduled a follow-up: metering-team -> 2026-04-11T10:00Z to review RPC batching and retry interactions in serverless environments.
ana_engineer: long-term fix: propose a small server-side dedupe window (configurable per account) that can match identical request fingerprints within 5s when idempotency absent; filing RFC ticket.
kevin_sales: i'll confirm with customer and send written remediation and the credit offer. closing loop unless billing needs more details. :white_check_mark:
